about: Real words for levels 1 to 7. Every letter or letter group makes its taught sound (or a taught second sound: th in this, s in dogs, ed in jumped). step is the first step by which all of a word's letters are introduced, or a later step the word names itself (blends, endings, two-syllable words). picture is the emoji for picture tasks. oralOnly words are never printed. name words are capitalized and used only in sentences and stories. split marks where a two-syllable word's second syllable starts; speak: text means the voice reads it as a whole word.
